svg.title: HR-V0 P0.6 watchdog-gated SR1 supply
svg.desc: Direct E-stop input channels are separated from the ordinary two-stage watchdog supply gate. P0.6 changes only the physical enclosure and compute allocation.
svg.text: HR-V0 control-panel P0.6 - watchdog-gated SR1 supply
PRELIMINARY - NOT APPROVED FOR FABRICATION OR ENERGIZATION
No KWD terminal in either loop
- PNOZ supply screen: 2.5 W steady; 0.5 A startup pulse for 5 ms. Contact duty/endurance remains unapproved.
- KWD welded/bypassed contacts can defeat the diagnostic gate, but are no longer connected to S0 return nodes.
- Gate, coil and feedback conductors require released separation from SR1 input/RESET/ARM wiring.
- Brownout, recovery, internal-short, contamination and power-cycle tests remain NOT EXECUTED.
No holes, wires, fabrication, fault injection or energization are authorized.
